# 📋 Workshop Agenda

### Data to be used by SKILL.md to create the Workshop App

- Architecture sketch + decision points: Define new flow and retrieval pattern
- Hands on: Index & Retrieval Implementation Plan: Finalize schema, query patterns, and grounding approach
- Hands-on working session: “Design the target search experience”: Implement / walkthrough working search + AI retrieval flow
- AI Agent Integration: Add conversational layer and grounded responses using search
- Relevance & Performance Optimization: Tune ranking, filters, and latency for conversational scenarios
- Validation & Evaluation: Define quality benchmarks, test queries, and success criteria
- Roadmap & Next Steps: Define Phase 2 delivery plan, milestones, and rollout approach
